totals.note: total MAE vs the actual total, D-I games with a closing total; t paired per game against the shipped totals (current inputs, shipped params). Walk variants change the tempo ridge (tlam: prior weight in games, shipped = lam 4), tempo carried over (tcarry 0.6) or the market total rating step (tk 0.2).

blend.note: margin MAE of w x model + (1 - w) x close, D-I games with a close; bestW is in-sample for that season, walkW fit on the seasons before it. Report only: the page shows the model margin, not the blend.

best.formula: p = Phi(m / sqrt(sd0^2 + c u)); games k: u = k/(k+gh) + k/(k+ga) (games each team has played); days L: u = 2 max(0, 1 - day/L), day from Nov 1

winProb.note: log loss of the home win, D-I games (no ties), shipped margin walk-forward; grid fit on 2016-20, t paired per game against the shipped constant sd

sims.note: past seasons from the morning of Dec 1, Jan 15, Feb 15: the rest of the regular season (conference tournaments and March left out) simulated 2000 times from the walk-forward ratings (power rating as the daily build makes it, weights fit on the seasons before), each game normal around its margin with the fit sd; each team's strength drawn once with sd sqrt(a^2 k/(k+games played) + b^2 x share of its season left) (a 0 or k none: fixed a). Scored per team and cut: CRPS of rest-of-season wins and conference wins, MAE of expected wins, log loss of a share of the conference title. t paired per team-cut against the live shock (a 2, k 8, b 4, with confh/alt home terms); "(home only)": home court in every game without the conference-home and altitude terms. Rating: cbb_tourney.team_rating (efficiency at the eff + bpi weight, Elo, long-memory margin) with BPI's home term in the home edge, the rating the daily build uses since Nov 2 2026 (before: efficiency and Elo only, ~half the game model's scale).

summary.totals: shipped: tempo prior weight tlam 2 (was the margin lam 4), tempo carried over 1.0 (0.6), market total step tk 0.5 (0.2), plus early (efficiency total minus market total x max(0, 1 - games/10)). Total MAE 2016-20 13.798 -> 13.756 (t -5.37), 2021-26 13.551 -> 13.508 (t -6.10); close 13.457 / 13.228. Margin on games with a close unchanged (9.2481 -> 9.2490 held out, t +1.05; tune t -0.17).
summary.winProb: not shipped: sd widening with fewer games played or early dates improves 2021-26 log loss (t -3 to -5.6) but no form reaches t <= -1.5 on 2016-20 (best -1.39).
summary.sims: shipped: strength shock sd sqrt(2^2 x 8/(8+games) + 4^2 x share of season left) in place of 3 sqrt(8/(8+games)); the sim margin now carries the model's conference-home and altitude terms (consistency with the game projections; home-only against it on rest-of-season wins CRPS t +0.82 tune / +2.93 held out).
summary.blend: report only (data/cbb_games_fit.json blend 0.2, shown as text on the model page; never used for projections). Best w by season 0.10-0.30; 20% model vs close: 2016-20 t -3.75, 2021-26 t -2.29.
